description: This Java source file defines the UniqueCertificateChainSSLContextBuilder class, which creates an SSLContext with a custom X509KeyManager that dynamically generates and manages a unique certificate chain for SSL connections.

classes.name: UniqueCertificateChainSSLContextBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for creating SSLContext instances with a custom X509KeyManager that generates a unique certificate chain.

classes.name: UniqueCertificateChainX509KeyManager
classes.description: A custom implementation of X509KeyManager that dynamically creates and provides a certificate chain and private key for SSL connections.

methods.name: uniqueCertificateChainSSLContext
methods.description: Creates and initializes an SSLContext with a custom X509KeyManager that provides a unique certificate chain.

methods.name: getClientAliases
methods.description: Returns the client alias for the key manager.

methods.name: chooseClientAlias
methods.description: Selects the client alias for SSL handshake.

methods.name: getServerAliases
methods.description: Returns the server alias for the key manager.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Selects the server alias for SSL handshake.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the certificate chain for the given alias.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key for the given alias.
